'''Dragon Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{Item|Ender Pearl}} collection at {{Coll|Ender Pearl 4}}, {{Coll|Ender Pearl 6}}, and {{Coll|Ender Pearl 9}} with increasing capacity. The '''{{ID|Small Dragon Sack!Small Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, '''{{ID|Medium Dragon Sack!Medium Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and '''{{ID|Large Dragon Sack!Large Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item.
